name: Vaseline Intensive Care Vitamin B3 Body Oil 200ml | International
description:
Product details of Vaseline Intensive Care Vitamin B3 Body Oil – 200ml (International)

Product Type: Body Oil / Moisturizing Oil

Size: 200ml

Origin: International

Key Features:

Vitamin B3 Enriched: Helps improve skin tone and texture for a radiant, even complexion

Deep Moisturization: Provides intense hydration, leaving skin soft, smooth, and supple

Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Absorbs quickly without leaving an oily residue

Restores Skin Barrier: Strengthens the skin’s natural moisture barrier for long-lasting hydration

Suitable for All Skin Types: Gentle enough for dry, sensitive, and normal skin

Daily Use Formula: Ideal for everyday application to maintain nourished, healthy-looking skin

Dermatologically Tested: Safe for sensitive skin, minimizes irritation

Vaseline Intensive Care Vitamin B3 Body Oil is a fast-absorbing, nourishing oil that revitalizes and deeply moisturizes your skin. Enriched with Vitamin B3, it helps even out skin tone, improve skin barrier function, and leave skin feeling soft, smooth, and radiant. Perfect for daily use, it keeps skin hydrated, glowing, and healthy without any greasy residue.
